author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
We test and review Bambu Lab's new A2L large format 3D printer. At $470, it's priced between the bed slinger A1 and the enclosed P2S, but with a bigger build volume than both. We show the tallest and largest things you can print on the A2L's build plate and demonstrate its ability to also work as a 2-axis cutter and pen plotter. 

Find Bambu Lab printers here: https://www.matterhackers.com/store/c/3d-printers/bambu-lab-3d-printers?aff=7553
Disclosure: This product was sent to us by the manufacturer for purposes of review and is not sponsored. 

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
